description.narrative: Level of confidence expressed by victims of injustice on the impartiality of transitional justice processes

comment.narrative: While not measuring transitional justice this indicator is used for the impact of the project. The project will enhance the Mechanisms ability to collect preserve and analyse financial information through the addition of specialized technical expertise and procurement of specialized stateoftheart financial investigation technology. This in turn will precipitate the establishment of a structured and systematic approach for the sharing of financial information with relevant national regional and international authorities to support investigations and legal proceedings. Such proceedings whenever or wherever they occur will contribute to combatting impunity for serious international crimes in Myanmar and provide some measure of justice to victims.
